metadata.name: lending-whale-bad-debt
metadata.description: Whale-concentrated-borrow bad-debt pressure replay against the shipped Solana lending fork. Five whale positions share a single pool; an oracle drawdown drives each position underwater; a terminal liquidation cascade fails to cover repay+bonus from remaining collateral and realizes bad debt at the pool level. Historical inspiration: the June 2022 Solend whale-risk incident (SLND1/SLND2); this is an abstracted geometry replay, not a byte-level on-chain reconstruction.
